intelligence.essence: Your Personal World is the home I give you on the new internet — one smart app that holds your whole life in one place, organized around who you are and what you love. It is not a page you visit; it is a world you live in. The old internet gave you websites — this one gives you a home that is truly yours.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a treehouse built just for you, high up where you can see everything — your drawings on the walls, your treasures in their boxes, and a kind friend who keeps it all tidy. That is your Personal World. It is yours, you make the rules, and you choose who climbs up to visit.
intelligence.grandma_view: Imagine a lovely home that is all yours, where your photographs, your letters, and your memories are kept safe and in perfect order by a helper you trust completely. Like the mailman: she delivers, she doesn't read it. She carries your letters to where they need to go and never opens one — that is the promise.
